The must-sees

4 places Wizzy will tap you for first, each with a story and something to look for.

  1. 01
    Viewpoint

    Dune 7

    Walkers and sandboarders climb its steep ridge for views over the desert and the bay. From the top, the town and the Atlantic lie spread out below.

    Look for

    On a windy day, watch the crest: sand streams off the sharp ridge like smoke as the wind slowly moves the dune.

  2. 02
    Waterfront

    Pelican Point

    Thousands of Cape fur seals haul out at the tip. The spit shelters the bay, the best natural harbour on the coast.

  3. 03
    Church · 1880

    Rhenish Mission Church

    It was made in Hamburg, shipped in parts, and put up in 1880. It is now a national monument.

  4. 04
    Waterfront

    Walvis Bay Lagoon

    Thousands of greater and lesser flamingos feed here, along with pelicans and waders. The lagoon has been a Ramsar wetland of international importance since 1995.

    Look for

    Tell the two flamingos apart: lesser flamingos are smaller and deeper pink with dark bills; greater flamingos are taller and paler, with a pink bill tipped black.
